results.title: US places 11 African countries on highest Level 4 'Do Not Travel' advisory list amid rising security threats | Business Insider Africa
results.snippet:
The US has issued its highest Level 4 'Do not travel' advisory for 11 African countries due to serious security risks.
 Reasons for the warnings include terrorism, kidnapping, crime, civil unrest, armed conflict, and inadequate healthcare.
